serviceDetails.title: How do you build the system for my home?
paras: We start with a home survey. We measure each room, look at windows, walls and insulation, and talk about how you use your home and hot water. From this we work out the right boiler size and the size of each radiator.
Getting the sizing right is what makes a system warm and cheap to run. Too small and rooms stay cold. Too big and you waste gas.
serviceDetails.alt: Engineer planning a central heating system in Watford

serviceDetails.title: What is included in a full central heating system?
paras: A full central heating installation from AR Heating covers:
list: A new A rated boiler sized for your home
New pipework, run neatly and hidden where possible
New radiators with thermostatic radiator valves
A hot water cylinder where your home needs one
System flush, fill, testing and balancing
Handover, warranty registration and Gas Safe paperwork
serviceDetails.alt: Central heating system with boiler, pipework and radiators

serviceDetails.title: Can you fit central heating in an older home?
paras: Yes. Many older homes in and around Watford have old systems, storage heaters or no central heating at all. We plan the pipe routes around your home to keep disruption low, and choose radiators sized for high ceilings, solid walls and older windows.
If your home has some sound pipework, we can often reuse part of it and focus the work where it matters.
serviceDetails.alt: Central heating being fitted in an older Watford home

serviceDetails.title: Which boiler suits my central heating?
paras: The right boiler depends on your home and hot water use. A combi suits smaller homes with one bathroom, with no tank needed. A system boiler with a cylinder suits homes with two or more bathrooms, as it can feed several taps at once. We fit Worcester Bosch, Vaillant, Ideal and Baxi boilers, with warranties of up to 10 years depending on the model.
serviceDetails.alt: Choosing between combi and system boilers for central heating

serviceDetails.title: Will the system last?
paras: We use trusted parts, fit them with care, and test the whole system before we leave. We flush the system clean, add inhibitor to protect the pipes, and balance every radiator so each room heats evenly.
With a yearly boiler service and an occasional check of the system water, a well fitted central heating system gives many years of reliable warmth.
serviceDetails.alt: Engineer balancing radiators after a central heating installation

serviceDetails.title: How much does central heating cost?
paras: The cost depends on the size of your home, the number of radiators, the boiler type and how much pipework is needed. We visit, survey your home and give you a fixed price in writing. The price we quote is the price you pay.
Want to upgrade part of your system instead? See our heating installation page for radiator, boiler and control upgrades.

faqs.q: How long does a full central heating installation take?
faqs.a: Usually two to four days, depending on the size of your home. We give you a clear plan before we start.

faqs.q: Can you fit heating in an older home?
faqs.a: Yes. We plan the work around your home and reuse sound pipework where we can.

faqs.q: How many radiators do I need?
faqs.a: We work out the number and size from each room's size, windows and use, so every room stays warm.

faqs.q: Do I need a combi or a system boiler?
faqs.a: A combi suits homes with one bathroom. A system boiler suits homes with two or more bathrooms.

faqs.q: Will new central heating lower my bills?
faqs.a: In most cases, yes. A modern A rated boiler with good controls uses less gas to keep your home warm.
Sometimes, to run new pipes. We keep this to a minimum, protect your home and put everything back neatly.

faqs.q: What is the difference between this and heating installation?
faqs.a: This page covers full central heating systems. Our heating installation page covers upgrades such as extra radiators, underfloor heating and new controls.

faqs.q: Which boiler brands do you fit?
faqs.a: Worcester Bosch, Vaillant, Ideal and Baxi, with warranties of up to 10 years depending on the model.

faqs.q: Do you take away the old system?
faqs.a: Yes. We remove the old boiler, radiators and pipework we replace, and leave your home tidy.
